observations: Photo 0 shows a keyboard/PSR-style electronic instrument with many keys (looks like a full-size arranger keyboard).
Brand/model text appears on the front panel area; the label looks like 'PSR-550' (partially readable).
There is a built-in display and multiple buttons/ports on the control panel.
The speaker grille is visible at the bottom front.
No power-on screen, no audio/video, and no close-up of the model plate/serial.

claims.evidence: No photo/video showing it powered on, playing, or any display/function test.

risks.risk: Model/variant mismatch (label may be unclear; could be a different PSR model or a different unit).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model nameplate/label and serial number on the back/bottom, plus the front panel model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case: PSR-550 not confirmed (treated as generic/unknown PSR keyboard condition).

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys, speakers, display, buttons, or power supply may be faulty).
risks.proof: Short video: power on, show the display, play a few notes, demonstrate at least one style/voice button, and show volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (treated as needs testing / possibly faulty).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or damage not visible (power adapter, sustain pedal, or physical cracks).
risks.proof: Photos of everything included (adapter/pedal/manual if any) and close-ups of corners/hinges/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories and possible minor damage.

risks.risk: Screen/display issues or intermittent faults (may work briefly but fail later).
risks.proof: Video showing continuous operation for a few minutes (changing voices/styles and confirming stable display).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially intermittent (worst-case: not reliably working).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model/serial label (front and back/bottom).
Video of power-on with the display visible, then playing keys and changing at least one setting (voice/style) with audible output.
Photo of included items (power adapter, any pedal) and close-ups of ports/corners.
response.reason: The item appears to be a PSR-550 from the front label, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable from the single photo (no power-on/test evidence). To price safely in Oyo, I need proof it powers on and plays correctly.
